authors: W. Li, I. Mourachko, M. W. Noel, T. F. Gallagher
title: Millimeter-wave spectroscopy of cold Rb Rydberg atoms in a magneto-optical trap: Quantum defects of the ns, np, and nd series
method: single-photon ns-np and two-photon ns-(n+1)s, nd-(n+1)d millimeter-wave resonance spectroscopy; ns-np in 300 K background vapour with trap field off, two-photon transitions in a 85Rb MOT
uncertainty: per-interval values given (10-47 kHz for intervals; Table IV corrected values without own uncertainty)
conversion: Not exported, quantity 'hyperfine interval' (derived values): 12 rows (28s1/2 hfs, 29s1/2 hfs, 30s1/2 hfs, 31s1/2 hfs, 32s1/2 hfs, 33s1/2 hfs, 28s1/2 hfs, 29s1/2 hfs, ...).

The data are 85Rb, rydstate's Rb has the atomic mass 86.909180529 u: intervals are multiplied by the ratio of the reduced masses mu(Rb) / mu(85Rb) = 1.000000148480 (the quantum defects are the same); energies from the ground state are not scaled, they need a free offset in the fit (their binding energies differ by the same relative amount, less than 1 MHz for n >= 20).
caveats: intervals only; absolute energies require an anchor (e.g. mack2011 or NIST)
Table III and Table I are not independent
